pages.title: Your Horse Only
pages.text: An owned horse only answers to you. Anyone else who tries to ride it as the main rider is bucked off at once. It will still accept a second rider - but only while you're already in the saddle.

pages.title: Naming a Friend
pages.text:
To let one particular player ride on their own, type **/horse trust PlayerName**. It covers every horse you own, now and later, and **/horse untrust** takes it back.

See **Trusted Riders** for what that does and doesn't hand over.

pages.title: Toggle It Off
pages.text: Servers can turn this off in **config/icys-better-horses.json** by setting **horse_exclusivity** to **no** - then any player can ride any owned horse, handy for shared stables. The same file also toggles stabilizers, medkits, hitchposts, hooves, and multi-riding.
